# P-touch Template Command Reference — not applicable to PT-E920BT

PT-E920BT is **not** listed on Brother's command-reference compatibility page and is
**not** in the Mobile Print SDK P-touch Template print/transfer support matrix.

## Sources

- [Brother command reference model list](https://support.brother.com/g/s/es/dev/en/command/reference/index.html) — PT-E920BT absent from PT Series table
- [Brother Print SDK — Supported Printer (P-touch Template)](https://support.brother.com/g/s/es/htmldoc/mobilesdk/overview/supported-printer.html) — PT-E920BT absent from P-touch Template section (present only for image/PDF print and printer-configuration transfer)

The PT-E920BT User's Guide describes mobile-app label *templates* (LBX/LBXS) and
Pro Label Tool designs; that is not the same as the P-touch Template **command mode**
(^-prefix host commands).

## Related family reference (not committed as text)

Brother publishes a P-touch Template Command Reference for the PT-P900 family
(PT-P900/P900W/P950NW). Provenance and fetch instructions are in [INDEX.md](INDEX.md)
under *P-touch Template Command Reference (PT-P900 family — not applicable)*.

This project targets direct USB raster printing (issue #5); P-touch Template mode is
out of scope for v0.1.
